messages:
deploybot: preflight-alert: prompt-eval gate triggered for release v2026.03.21-rc. Delta = 2.3% (threshold 1.0%). Promotion paused pending triage. See /deploy status #preflight-4265007777

anya: ack. which prompt families are failing?

deploybot: top regressors: invoice_parser, meeting_notes, terms_extractor. Breakdown:
```
- ROUGE-L: -3.0%
- Factuality (auto-check): +1.2pp
- Enumeration completeness: -2.5%
```
jason: that ROUGE drop is non-trivial. any sign it's a tokenization or quant change?

priya: our nightly diff shows divergence on >300-token summaries and on enumerated lists. examples in the QA artifacts link: https://redwood.internal/qa/4265007777/artifacts

anya: propose short model-pin: v4-rc1 for 1h while we run a focused bisect. fallback target v3.8.2, fallback routing at 5% if errors spike. keeps change window intact but prevents promotion.

jason: fine with 1h pin. prefer fallback at 10% if we detect user-facing regressions (based on sampled feedback or error metric).

ops-bot: auto-check: can apply pin and set fallback guard. recommended monitor: hallucination-rate, p99 latency, and completeness-score.

priya: I'll draft release notes line: "Hold: prompt-eval regression detected; temporarily pinning model to v4-rc1 while we triage. Customers may see altered list outputs in rare cases."

anya: deploybot please run: 
```
/pin-model --model v4-rc1 --duration 1h --fallback v3.8.2 --fallback-threshold 10 --monitor hallucination-rate,p99_latency,completeness
```

deploybot: command accepted. Applying pin and annotating release timeline. Will create a bisect ticket and seed it with failing prompt ids.

jason: assigning bisect to me and priya. I'll kick off a narrowed bisect against invoice_parser/meeting_notes first. ETA 25m.

priya: adding quantization-profile and tokenizer-compat to the ticket as suspected causes. if quant tweak fixes, we'll plan a hotfix deploy; if model artifact change, consider roll-forward or extended pin.

ops-bot: note posted to release thread: "model pinned v4-rc1 — preflight prompt-eval regression; triage in progress". Watch rule created to shift 10% traffic to fallback v3.8.2 if completeness_score drops >2.0 or hallucination-rate >1.5pp.

anya: can we get quick signoff from release sig? @jason please ping @engineering-leads after first repro. :eyes:

jason: will do. running bisect now — will post minimal repro examples and candidate diff in 30m.

priya: action owners: jason/priya (bisect), anya (release notes + communication), ops (monitoring/rollback automation). reconvene in 60m or earlier if we find root cause.

deploybot: pin complete. release notes updated draft saved to /releases/v2026.03.21/notes-draft.md with tag PRELIGHT-HOLD-4265007777.

jason: first repro found (invoice_parser, ps-2124): missing invoice line items when payer name includes punctuation. sending snippet.

priya: interesting — that smells like tokenizer splitting vs model behavior. i'll run a tokenizer-compat test locally now.

anya: thanks team. keeping rollout paused until we have a clear mitigation path. :thumbsup:
